messages:
Anya: Quick FYI — brought up qrank-v3 int8 on small holdout. NDCG@10 drop on short_query_bench: 0.455 -> 0.436 (-4.2%). MRR change negligible.

Miguel: do we have per-query examples? short queries are often punctuation-sensitive.

Anya: uploading a tiny diff sample. Two queries where rank flipped:
1) query: "how to install?"  -> gold doc id 34 ranked 2 -> 5
2) query: "refund policy" -> gold doc id 112 stayed at 1

Devon: any prep/normalization changes in the candidate pipeline? last deploy touched query-token-cleaner.

Anya: candidate-prep v2.9.1 was rolled into the canary image. I checked the config: "strip_trailing_punct" was false for some dataset_ids due to a mapping fallback bug.

Sasha: That would explain hits on short queries that end with ? or ! — reranker gets altered input vs baseline.

Miguel: Can we reproduce by toggling strip_trailing_punct? run eval with/without and diff.

Anya: running quick local:
```
./eval/bin/run --model qrank-v3-int8 --holdout short_query_bench --slices "len(query)<=6" --paired-boot 5000 --seed 2026 --toggle-strip-punct on,off
```

EvalBot: Job queued: eval-4829001 (paired boot 5k). Estimated 28m.

Devon: I'll patch candidate-prep mapping so the dataset_id fallback doesn't skip the flag. Small PR incoming.

Anya: partial paired results (first 1k boots): median per-query delta -0.0087, paired p-value 0.02. The delta concentrates on queries ending with punctuation.

Sasha: if p<0.05 that's unlikely to be noise. But since it's linked to prep bug, fix + rerun full should clear up.

Miguel: also check impact on long_doc_bench and support_faqs; we don't want any accidental uplift loss.

Anya: confirmed long_doc_bench unchanged (+0.1%), support_faqs tiny drop (-0.3%). Looks isolated.

Devon: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/candidate-prep/pull/210 — adds explicit defaults and a unit test that runs sample dataset mapping and asserts strip_trailing_punct true for web_short.

DeployBot: Candidate-prep patch rolled into canary image canary-2026-03-20-3

Anya: redeployed canary, requeued eval. EvalBot: Job restarted eval-4829001 on canary-2026-03-20-3.

EvalBot: Job complete: paired p-value 0.48, median delta -0.0004, ndcg diff -0.12% (within noise).

Sasha: Good. Action items: 1) Devon merge PR and backport to stable, 2) Anya prepare a short ops note for the customer-impact channels, 3) Miguel add a regression test in eval-harness for punctuation-sensitive queries.

Devon: will merge + cherry-pick.

Miguel: I'll add the eval-harness test, using the short_query_bench subset and paired bootstrap assertion.

Anya: Thanks all. I'll keep canary gradual for 24h and monitor per-query outlier list.

Miguel: nice quick turnaround :thumbsup:
